response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(st.station_avg) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st.station_avg - g.overall_avg) AS mean_above_average FROM st CROSS JOIN g WHERE st.station_avg > g.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: "Above average" is measured against the overall average bandwidth usage across all telescopes with non-null bandusagepct (each telescope reading weighted equally), not against the average of station averages.
The "mean bandwidth usage" is the mean of the qualifying stations' per-station averages, and "how far above average" is the mean of (station average minus overall average) across those stations.
Stations with no non-null bandusagepct values (or no telescopes) are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: "Average" is the mean of the per-station averages (each station weighted equally) rather than the mean over all telescopes.
